blocks.text: Qizil kitobda **used to do** o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 36-dars; batafsil → 18-dars): I **used to play** football — ilgari futbol **o'ynardim**, endi o'ynamayman. Bu darsdagi **be used to** tashqi ko'rinishidan o'xshaydi, lekin butunlay boshqa ibora: biror narsa siz uchun **odatiy, tanish, g'alati emas** — siz unga **ko'nikkansiz**. O'zbekchada: «...ga o'rganib qolganman», «...ga ko'nikkanman», «...ga odatlanganman». I**'m used to** the cold — Sovuqqa **o'rganib qolganman** (u menga qiyinchilik tug'dirmaydi).

Ikki holatni farqlang: **be used to** — natija, holat (allaqachon ko'nikkansiz); **get used to** — jarayon (ko'nikib boryapsiz, ko'nikasiz yoki ko'nika olmayapsiz). Bu xuddi **be married** (uylangan) va **get married** (uylanmoq) farqiga o'xshaydi: **be** — holat, **get** — o'zgarish.

rows: I**'m used to** the noise. / I**'m used to** it.
She**'s used to working** at night.
You'll soon **get used to** the climate.
We **aren't used to** eating so late.

items.text: Aziz grew up in the mountains, so he**'s used to** cold winters.
items.translation: Aziz tog'da o'sgan, shuning uchun qahraton qishlarga **o'rganib qolgan**.

items.text: I**'m** not **used to** this keyboard yet — I keep making mistakes.
items.translation: Bu klaviaturaga hali **ko'nikmaganman** — tinmay xato qilyapman.

items.text: Don't worry, you**'ll get used to** the traffic in a few weeks.
items.translation: Xavotir olmang, bir-ikki haftada tirbandlikka **ko'nikib ketasiz**.

blocks.text: to bu yerda — predlog, shuning uchun -ing

Eng muhim grammatik nuqta: **be used to** dagi **to** — infinitiv belgisi emas, **predlog** (xuddi **look forward to** dagi kabi, → 60-dars). Predlogdan keyin fe'l doim **-ing** shaklida keladi. Tekshirish usuli: **to** dan keyin ot qo'yib ko'ring — «I'm used to **the noise**» to'g'ri bo'lsa, demak fe'l ham ot o'rnida turibdi va -ing oladi: I'm used to **getting up** early. «I'm used to get up» — xato. -ing oldidan boshqa shaxs ham kelishi mumkin: He isn't used to **people disagreeing** with him — U odamlarning unga qarshi chiqishiga o'rganmagan.

rows: I'm used to **working** in a noisy office.
She's getting used to **her new boss**.
She's getting used to **reporting** to a new boss.
We aren't used to **eating** spicy food.
You'll get used to **the early shifts**.
You'll get used to **starting** work at six.

items.text: Doctors in the emergency department **are used to working** long night shifts.
items.translation: Tez yordam bo'limi shifokorlari uzoq tungi smenalarda **ishlashga o'rganib qolgan**.

items.text: James **is used to driving** on the left, so Tashkent felt strange at first.
items.translation: Jeyms chap tomondan **haydashga o'rgangan**, shuning uchun Toshkent avvaliga g'alati tuyuldi.

items.text: Our teacher **isn't used to** students arguing with her.

blocks.text: used to do yoki be used to doing?

Bu ikki ibora o'zbek o'quvchisini eng ko'p chalg'itadi, chunki ikkalasida ham «used to» bor. **used to + fe'l** (be siz) — o'tmishdagi odat yoki holat, hozir esa u yo'q; faqat o'tgan zamon haqida. **be used to + -ing** — ko'nikma: harakat siz uchun odatiy, hech qanday qiyinchilik tug'dirmaydi; istalgan zamonda bo'ladi. Birinchisi «...rdim», ikkinchisi «...ga o'rganib qolganman» deb tarjima qilinadi. Gapda **be** (am / is / are / was) bormi — shunga qarang.

rows: I **used to live** in a village.
I**'m used to living** in a village.
I**'m getting used to living** in a village.

items.text: Bekzod **used to smoke**, but he gave up two years ago.
items.translation: Bekzod ilgari **chekardi**, lekin ikki yil oldin tashladi.

items.text: After ten years in London, Kate **is used to taking** the tube everywhere.
items.translation: Londonda o'n yil yashab, Keyt hamma joyga metroda **borishga o'rganib qolgan**.

items.text: I **didn't use to like** spicy food, but now I**'m used to** it.
items.translation: Ilgari achchiq taomni **yoqtirmasdim**, lekin endi unga **o'rganib qolganman**.

blocks.text: Istalgan zamonda: be va get tuslanadi

**be used to** va **get used to** dagi **be** va **get** oddiy fe'l kabi barcha zamonlarda o'zgaradi, **used to** qismi esa o'zgarmaydi: I **wasn't used to** (ko'nikmagan edim), I**'ve got used to** (ko'nikib qoldim), you**'ll get used to** (ko'nikib ketasiz), I**'m getting used to** (ko'nikib boryapman), I **can't get used to** (hech ko'nika olmayapman), it **took** me a year **to get used to** (ko'nikishim uchun bir yil kerak bo'ldi). Og'zaki nutqda **it took some getting used to** — «ko'nikish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi» iborasi ham ko'p uchraydi. **used to do** esa faqat o'tgan zamonda: «I use to» yoki «I will used to» degan shakl yo'q.

items.text: At first Sarah **wasn't used to** the heat in Bukhara, but she soon **got used to** it.
items.translation: Avvaliga Sara Buxorodagi jaziramaga **o'rganmagan edi**, lekin tez orada unga **ko'nikdi**.

items.text: It **took** me a month **to get used to** wearing glasses.
items.translation: Ko'zoynak **taqishga ko'nikishim** uchun bir oy kerak bo'ldi.

items.text: **Have** you **got used to** the new software yet?

blocks.text: Rasmiy uslubda **be used to** o'rniga **be accustomed to** ham ishlatiladi, undan keyin ham -ing keladi: Our staff **are accustomed to dealing** with difficult customers. **get used to** ning rasmiyroq sinonimlari — **get accustomed to**, **adapt to** (+ -ing).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) **to** dan keyin oddiy fe'l: «I'm used to work late» → I'm used to **working** late. (2) **be** tushib qoladi: «I used to living here» → I**'m used to living** here. (3) «Men erta turishga o'rganganman» ni «I used to get up early» deb tarjima qilish — bu «ilgari erta turardim» degani; to'g'risi: I**'m used to getting up** early. (4) «I'm use to it» — yozuvda doim **used**, `-d` tushirilmaydi. (5) «I'm using to...» — bu umuman boshqa fe'l (foydalanmoq).

Eslab qolish: «ilgari ...rdim, endi yo'q» — **used to** + fe'l. «...ga o'rganib qolganman / ko'nikkanman» — **be used to** + -ing. «...ga ko'nikmoq, ko'nikib ketmoq» — **get used to** + -ing. **be** bormi — demak keyin -ing yoki ot.

rows: He**'s used to working** under pressure.
He**'s getting used to** the new team.
He **isn't used to** such cold weather.

examples.title: **be used to** + noun: the noise, the heat, it
examples.description: be used to + ot yoki olmosh: biror narsa siz uchun odatiy, unga ko'nikkansiz.

sentences.text: After five years in Manchester, Dilnoza **is used to** the rain.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda besh yil yashab, Dilnoza yomg'irga **o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: Farmers in Khiva **are used to** the summer heat, but tourists often suffer.
sentences.translation: Xivadagi dehqonlar yozgi jaziramaga **o'rganib qolgan**, sayyohlar esa ko'pincha qiynaladi.

sentences.text: My neighbours play loud music every night, but I**'m used to** it now.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarim har kecha baland ovozda musiqa qo'yishadi, lekin men endi bunga **ko'nikib qolganman**.

sentences.text: Tom works in a busy restaurant kitchen, so he**'s used to** stress.
sentences.translation: Tom gavjum restoran oshxonasida ishlaydi, shuning uchun stressga **o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: Our cat **is used to** strangers because we often have guests.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz begonalarga **o'rganib qolgan**, chunki bizda tez-tez mehmon bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Surgeons **are used to** long hours on their feet in the operating theatre.
sentences.translation: Jarrohlar operatsiya xonasida soatlab oyoqda turishga **o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: As a pilot, Oliver **is used to** sudden changes in the weather.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi sifatida Oliver ob-havoning keskin o'zgarishlariga **ko'nikkan**.

sentences.text: Teachers at this school **are used to** large classes of forty pupils.
sentences.translation: Bu maktab o'qituvchilari qirq o'quvchili katta sinflarga **odatlangan**.

sentences.text: Since we live near the airport, we**'re** completely **used to** the sound of planes.
sentences.translation: Aeroport yaqinida yashaganimiz uchun samolyotlar ovoziga butunlay **o'rganib qolganmiz**.

sentences.text: **Is** your son **used to** the new kindergarten yet, or does he still cry?
sentences.translation: O'g'lingiz yangi bog'chaga **o'rganib qoldimi** yoki hali ham yig'layaptimi?

examples.title: **be used to** + -ing: used to doing things
examples.description: be used to dan keyin fe'l kelsa — doim -ing shaklida, chunki to bu yerda predlog.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is used to getting up** at six because he runs every morning.
sentences.translation: Bekzod har tong yugurgani uchun soat oltida **turishga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: Journalists **are used to working** under pressure, especially before an election.
sentences.translation: Jurnalistlar, ayniqsa saylov oldidan, bosim ostida **ishlashga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: I live alone, so I**'m used to cooking** just for myself.
sentences.translation: Yolg'iz yashayman, shuning uchun faqat o'zimga **ovqat qilishga o'rganib qolganman**.

sentences.text: Sarah**'s used to speaking** in public — she gives lectures every week.
sentences.translation: Sara ko'pchilik oldida **gapirishga o'rganib qolgan** — har hafta ma'ruza o'qiydi.

sentences.text: In our family we**'re used to having** dinner together at eight.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda soat sakkizda birga **kechki ovqat qilishga odatlanganmiz**.

sentences.text: Programmers **are used to sitting** in front of a screen for hours.
sentences.translation: Dasturchilar soatlab ekran oldida **o'tirishga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: Since his parents both worked, Aziz **was used to looking** after his little sisters.
sentences.translation: Ota-onasi ikkalasi ham ishlagani uchun Aziz singillariga **qarashga o'rganib qolgan edi**.

sentences.text: Kate travels a lot for work, so she**'s used to sleeping** in hotels.
sentences.translation: Keyt ish yuzasidan ko'p safar qiladi, shuning uchun mehmonxonalarda **uxlashga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **used to driving** on narrow mountain roads, or shall I drive?
sentences.translation: Tor tog' yo'llarida **haydashga o'rganganmisiz** yoki men haydayinmi?

sentences.text: My grandmother **is used to doing** everything by hand, so she doesn't trust the dishwasher.
sentences.translation: Buvim hamma ishni qo'lda **qilishga o'rganib qolgan**, shuning uchun idish yuvish mashinasiga ishonmaydi.

examples.title: Not used to it yet: **isn't used to** / **Are you used to**?
examples.description: Inkor va so'roq: hali ko'nikmagan, g'ayrioddiy holat; savol → javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: Oliver **isn't used to** spicy food, so please don't add too much pepper.
sentences.translation: Oliver achchiq taomga **o'rganmagan**, shuning uchun iltimos, qalampirni ko'p solmang.

sentences.text: **Are** you **used to** the time difference yet? — Not really, I still wake up at three.
sentences.translation: Vaqt farqiga **ko'nikdingizmi**? — Unchalik emas, hali ham tungi soat uchda uyg'onib ketyapman.

sentences.text: We **aren't used to** eating so late — in Tashkent we have dinner at seven.
sentences.translation: Biz bunchalik kech **ovqatlanishga o'rganmaganmiz** — Toshkentda soat yettida kechki ovqat qilamiz.

sentences.text: Madina felt nervous because she **wasn't used to** speaking English on the phone.
sentences.translation: Madina hayajonlandi, chunki telefonda inglizcha **gaplashishga o'rganmagan edi**.

sentences.text: **Is** Jasur **used to** his new boss? — Yes, they get on really well now.
sentences.translation: Jasur yangi boshlig'iga **ko'nikdimi**? — Ha, hozir ular juda yaxshi chiqishib ketishgan.

sentences.text: The children **weren't used to** such cold weather and caught colds.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bunday sovuq havoga **o'rganmagan edi** va shamollab qolishdi.

sentences.text: Why are you so tired? — I**'m not used to** standing all day in the shop.
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik charchading? — Kun bo'yi do'konda **tik turishga o'rganmaganman**.

sentences.text: Students from the villages often **aren't used to** life in a big city.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdan kelgan talabalar ko'pincha katta shahar hayotiga **o'rganmagan** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Were** you **used to** working with children before you became a teacher?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi bo'lishingizdan oldin bolalar bilan **ishlashga o'rgangan edingizmi**?

sentences.text: Honestly, Emma still **isn't used to** the idea of working from home.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, Emma hali ham uydan ishlash g'oyasiga **ko'nikmagan**.

examples.title: **get used to**: the process of getting used to
examples.description: get used to — ko'nikish jarayoni: ko'nikib boryapman, ko'nikib ketasiz, hech ko'nika olmayapman.

sentences.text: Don't panic — you**'ll** soon **get used to** the new booking system.
sentences.translation: Vahima qilmang — yangi bron tizimiga tezda **ko'nikib ketasiz**.

sentences.text: I**'m** slowly **getting used to** living without a car.
sentences.translation: Mashinasiz yashashga asta-sekin **ko'nikib boryapman**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **can't get used to** the long dark winters in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Edinburgdagi uzun va qorong'i qishlarga hech **ko'nika olmayapti**.

sentences.text: It was hard at first, but the kids **are getting used to** their new school.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga qiyin bo'ldi, lekin bolalar yangi maktabga **ko'nikib borishyapti**.

sentences.text: New employees usually need a few weeks to **get used to** our software.
sentences.translation: Yangi xodimlarga dasturimizga **ko'nikish** uchun odatda bir necha hafta kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: How long did it take you **to get used to** wearing contact lenses?
sentences.translation: Kontakt linzalar taqishga **ko'nikishingiz** uchun qancha vaqt ketdi?

sentences.text: My father **will never get used to** paying for everything by phone.
sentences.translation: Otam hamma narsa uchun telefon orqali to'lashga hech qachon **ko'nikmaydi**.

sentences.text: Every time I visit London, I have to **get used to** the traffic on the left again.
sentences.translation: Har safar Londonga borganimda chap tomonlama harakatga qaytadan **ko'nikishimga** to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: **Getting used to** a new country takes time, so be patient with yourself.
sentences.translation: Yangi mamlakatga **ko'nikish** vaqt talab qiladi, shuning uchun o'zingizga sabrli bo'ling.

sentences.text: After the operation Grandpa had to **get used to** walking with a stick.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin bobom hassa bilan yurishga **ko'nikishi** kerak bo'ldi.

examples.title: Tenses: **got used to**, **have got used to**
examples.description: be va get istalgan zamonda tuslanadi: ko'nikdim, ko'nikib qoldim, ko'nikmagan edim; used to qismi o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.text: At first I hated the early shifts, but I soon **got used to** them.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga ertalabki smenalarni yomon ko'rardim, lekin tez orada ularga **ko'nikdim**.

sentences.text: James **has** finally **got used to** the Uzbek habit of drinking tea after every meal.
sentences.translation: Jeyms nihoyat har ovqatdan keyin choy ichish odatiga **ko'nikib qoldi**.

sentences.text: When we moved to Samarkand, we **weren't used to** the dry air.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga ko'chib kelganimizda quruq havoga **o'rganmagan edik**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **got used to** your new phone, or do you still miss the old one?
sentences.translation: Yangi telefoningizga **ko'nikdingizmi** yoki hali ham eskisini qo'msayapsizmi?

sentences.text: By the end of the course, the students **had got used to** speaking only English in class.
sentences.translation: Kurs oxiriga kelib talabalar darsda faqat inglizcha **gaplashishga ko'nikib qolishgan edi**.

sentences.text: It took Dilnoza almost a year **to get used to** living on her own.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga yolg'iz yashashga **ko'nikishi** uchun deyarli bir yil kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Once you**'ve got used to** the controls, the camera is very easy to use.
sentences.translation: Boshqaruv tugmalariga **ko'nikib olganingizdan** keyin kamerani ishlatish juda oson.

sentences.text: Tom **was used to** working alone, so teamwork was difficult for him at first.
sentences.translation: Tom yolg'iz **ishlashga o'rganib qolgan edi**, shuning uchun avvaliga jamoada ishlash unga qiyin bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Our dog **has never got used to** the sound of fireworks.
sentences.translation: Itimiz mushakbozlik ovoziga hanuzgacha **ko'nika olmagan**.

sentences.text: I don't think I**'ll** ever **get used to** waking up in the dark in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda qorong'ida uyg'onishga qachondir **ko'nikaman**, deb o'ylamayman.

examples.title: **used to do** or **be used to doing**?
examples.description: Ikki xil ma'no yonma-yon: used to + fe'l — o'tmish odati («...rdim»), be used to + -ing — ko'nikma («...ga o'rganib qolganman»).

sentences.text: Aziz **used to walk** to work every day before he bought a car.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashina sotib olgunicha har kuni ishga piyoda **borardi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is used to walking**, so a two-hour hike is easy for him.
sentences.translation: Aziz piyoda **yurishga o'rganib qolgan**, shuning uchun ikki soatlik sayr unga oson.

sentences.text: Before the pandemic, Sarah **used to commute** to Manchester every day.
sentences.translation: Pandemiyadan oldin Sara har kuni Manchesterga ishga **qatnardi**.

sentences.text: Now Sarah **is used to working** at her kitchen table.
sentences.translation: Endi Sara oshxona stoli ortida **ishlashga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: We **didn't use to** have a dishwasher, so we**'re used to** washing up by hand.
sentences.translation: Ilgari idish yuvish mashinamiz **yo'q edi**, shuning uchun idishlarni qo'lda **yuvishga o'rganib qolganmiz**.

sentences.text: My uncle **used to be** a lorry driver, so he**'s used to** driving through the night.
sentences.translation: Amakim ilgari yuk mashinasi haydovchisi **edi**, shuning uchun tun bo'yi **haydashga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **use to** play the piano? — Yes, but my fingers **aren't used to** it any more.
sentences.translation: Ilgari pianino **chalarmidingiz**? — Ha, lekin barmoqlarim endi bunga **o'rganmay qolgan**.

sentences.text: Jasur **used to hate** public speaking, but now he**'s** quite **used to** it.
sentences.translation: Jasur ilgari ko'pchilik oldida gapirishni **yomon ko'rardi**, endi esa bunga ancha **o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: Grandma **used to cook** on a wood fire, so the electric cooker **took some getting used to**.
sentences.translation: Buvim ilgari o'tinli o'choqda **ovqat pishirardi**, shuning uchun elektr plitaga **ko'nikish** biroz vaqt oldi.

sentences.text: Life in London **used to feel** strange to Nilufar, but she**'s used to** it now.
sentences.translation: London hayoti ilgari Nilufarga g'alati **tuyulardi**, lekin endi u bunga **o'rganib qolgan**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a new life in London
examples.description: Suhbat: Londonga ko'chib ketgan dugona yangi hayotga qanday ko'nikayotgani haqida gapiradi.

sentences.text: — So, Nilufar, how's life in London? **Are** you **used to** it yet?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Nilufar, London hayoti qanday? Unga **ko'nikdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Almost! The weather was a shock, but I**'m getting used to** it.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli! Ob-havo meni dovdiratib qo'ydi, lekin unga **ko'nikib boryapman**.

sentences.text: — What about the food? You **used to hate** anything without spices.
sentences.translation: — Ovqat-chi? Ilgari ziravorsiz har qanday taomni **yomon ko'rarding**.

sentences.text: — True, but I**'ve got used to** cooking for myself, so I'm fine.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, lekin o'zimga ovqat qilishga **ko'nikib qoldim**, shuning uchun muammo yo'q.

sentences.text: — And the job? At home you **weren't used to** working such long hours.
sentences.translation: — Ish-chi? Uyda bunchalik uzoq soat **ishlashga o'rganmagan eding**.

sentences.text: — That's the hardest part — I**'m** still **not used to** finishing at eight.
sentences.translation: — Eng qiyini shu — soat sakkizda ishdan chiqishga hali ham **o'rganmaganman**.

sentences.text: — Do you take the tube to work, or **are** you **used to** cycling now?
sentences.translation: — Ishga metroda borasanmi yoki endi velosipedda **yurishga o'rganib qoldingmi**?

sentences.text: — I cycle! At first the traffic scared me, but you **get used to** it.
sentences.translation: — Velosipedda! Avvaliga transport meni qo'rqitardi, lekin bunga **ko'nikib ketar ekansan**.

sentences.text: — I'm sure. And **are** your English colleagues **used to** your tea breaks?
sentences.translation: — Ishonaman. Ingliz hamkasblaring choy tanaffuslaringga **ko'nikishdimi**?

sentences.text: — They love them! They**'ll never get used to** drinking tea without milk, though.
sentences.translation: — Ular buni yaxshi ko'rishadi! Faqat choyni sutsiz ichishga hech qachon **ko'nikishmaydi**.

examples.title: Mixed: work, travel and new habits
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: be used to, get used to va used to do — murakkabroq, kontekstli gaplarda.

sentences.text: Football fans in Manchester **are used to** standing in the rain for ninety minutes.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi futbol muxlislari to'qson daqiqa yomg'ir ostida **turishga o'rganib qolgan**.

sentences.text: According to the survey, most office workers **have got used to** online meetings.
sentences.translation: So'rovnomaga ko'ra, ofis xodimlarining aksariyati onlayn yig'ilishlarga **ko'nikib qolgan**.

sentences.text: The new manager **isn't used to** people disagreeing with him openly.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer odamlarning u bilan ochiqchasiga **bahslashishiga o'rganmagan**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **used to be** shy, but at university she **got used to** meeting new people.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ilgari uyatchan **edi**, lekin universitetda yangi odamlar bilan tanishishga **ko'nikdi**.

sentences.text: If you move to Fergana, you**'ll** have to **get used to** much hotter summers.
sentences.translation: Farg'onaga ko'chsangiz, ancha issiq yozga **ko'nikishingizga** to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: After six months in space, astronauts have to **get used to** gravity again.
sentences.translation: Koinotda olti oy bo'lgandan keyin kosmonavtlar yana yerning tortish kuchiga **ko'nikishlari** kerak.

sentences.text: Patients who **are used to** taking painkillers often find it hard to stop.
sentences.translation: Og'riq qoldiruvchi dori ichishga **o'rganib qolgan** bemorlar ko'pincha uni to'xtatishga qiynaladi.

sentences.text: Why is Kate so quiet? — She**'s not used to** being the centre of attention.
sentences.translation: Keyt nega bunchalik jim? — U diqqat markazida bo'lishga **o'rganmagan**.

sentences.text: Since petrol prices went up, many families **are getting used to** using public transport.
sentences.translation: Benzin narxi oshgandan beri ko'p oilalar jamoat transportidan foydalanishga **ko'nikib boryapti**.

sentences.text: Even though Bekzod **used to live** in London, he still **isn't used to** British humour.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilgari Londonda **yashagan** bo'lsa ham, ingliz hazil-mutoyibasiga hali ham **ko'nikmagan**.
